gaps.sentence: If you don't know the word, look it ___ in a dictionary.
gaps.explanation: look a word up = find it in a dictionary/reference.

gaps.sentence: Please fill ___ this form and sign at the bottom.
gaps.explanation: fill in/out a form (British prefers in).

gaps.sentence: She came ___ with a brilliant solution to the problem.
gaps.explanation: come up with = produce an idea/plan/solution.
pick up = learn without formal study; also collect (pick somebody up).

gaps.sentence: Do you get ___ well with your new colleagues?
gaps.explanation: get on (with) = have a good relationship; also get along with (AmE).

gaps.sentence: Many consumers now opt ___ cheaper brands.
The two founders hit it ___ immediately.
gaps.explanation: hit it off = like each other and become friendly quickly.

gaps.sentence: The caterpillar will turn ___ a butterfly.
